spans.s:
दिलीप दिली-प, अस्, m. (said to be fr. दिली,
a name for the ancient Hāstina-pura or modern
Delhi, + प, a protector), N. of a king and ancestor
of Rāma, son of Aṃśu-mat and father of Bhagī-
ratha; [cf. दैलीपि.]
—दिलीप-चरित, अम्, n., N.
of the fifth chapter of the Pātāla-khaṇḍa or fourth
part of the Padma-Purāṇa.
—दिलीप-राज्, ट्, m. the
king of Dilīpa.
—दिलीप-वर-लाभ, अस्, m., N. of
the sixth chapter of the Pātāla-khaṇḍa.

दिलीर दिलीर, अस्, m. = शिलीन्ध्रक, a
mushroom.

दिल्ह दिल्ह, अस्, m., N. of a man; [cf.
दिह्ला.]
